notes_for_editor: Only a register entry and a heading-only Forest Lookouts page exist for this tower. The Forest Lookouts page has a photo (uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/3010051_orig.jpg) that was not downloaded or read, so any caption or detail in it is unverified. The index spells Pinckney and the Forest Lookouts page spells Pinkney; both name Polk County, so they are treated as one site, which is not confirmed by a county record. Brief record check: name, county, coordinates and gone status match the index; no correction proposed. Next steps if pursued: the Cavallerano book's Polk County entries, and the Texas A&M Forest Service records. Two WebSearch queries found no Pinckney-specific history.
